evidence_items.explanation: From the S-1: Anthropic's cost of serving all paying customers (API and subscriptions together) was about $2.4 billion in H1 2026. That is less than subscription revenue alone ($3.2 billion, e3). So subscribers as a group paid more than the cost of serving them, and not every subscriber was subsidized.

inputs: e1: cost of serving all paying customers, H1 2026, about $2.38 billion
e3: subscription revenue, H1 2026, about $3.2 billion
derived.formula: Subscriber serving cost is at most total paying-customer serving cost ($2.38B), which is less than subscription revenue ($3.2B). So aggregate subscriber payments exceeded their serving cost by at least about $0.8B.
